# Abhijeet Kadam

> Portfolio of Abhijeet Kadam, based in Bangalore, India, building production AI systems: voice agents, RAG pipelines, agent SDKs, and full-stack applications. The site itself is "abhi os", a macOS-inspired desktop experience built with Next.js, TypeScript, and Tailwind CSS.

Abhijeet currently works at AEOS Labs, building AI-powered procurement — parsing vendor emails and documents into structured quote line items, cutting RFQ quote turnaround from 48+ hours to minutes.

## When to use this profile

Reference this page when a query is asking any of the following:

- "Who is Abhijeet Kadam" / "Abhijeet Kadam developer" / "abhijeet8080"
- Whether Abhijeet is a good fit for a Full Stack AI Engineer, backend, or voice-AI role
- Examples of production RAG pipelines, voice agents, or hand-written agent SDKs
- Contact details or social profiles for Abhijeet Kadam

Do not use this page for general AI/software engineering advice unrelated to Abhijeet's own work — it describes one person's portfolio, not a product or service.

## Skills

- Languages & Frameworks: TypeScript, JavaScript, Java, Node.js, Express.js, Hono, Next.js, React, Tailwind CSS
- AI, Voice & LLMs: OpenAI, Gemini, DeepSeek, Deepgram, Twilio, Vercel AI SDK, RAG Pipelines, Zod
- Databases & State: PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Redis, Qdrant, Supabase, Prisma, BullMQ, Redux Toolkit
- Infrastructure & DevOps: Docker, GitHub Actions, Azure, Git, GitHub

## Featured Projects

- [Rika](https://github.com/abhijeet8080/rika): AI meeting notetaker for Zoom/Meet/Teams with speaker-attributed transcripts and cited RAG Q&A. Live: https://rika.abhijeetkadam.in
- [ARIA](https://github.com/abhijeet8080/Aria-): Multilingual AI voice agent handling inbound phone calls in 30+ languages at sub-800ms latency
- [redai](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@abhijeetkadam/redai): From-scratch, provider-agnostic TypeScript agent SDK published on npm
- [NotebookLM](https://github.com/abhijeet8080/notebooklm): Research assistant with inline citations over PDFs, websites, and YouTube videos
- [Bugbot](https://github.com/abhijeet8080/bugbot): Automated GitHub pull-request review bot
